Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can display a title card.

Warn.Empty: The title card is empty: enter at least one text.
Warn.InvalidImage: Background image ignored: invalid path or format.
Warn.InvalidSound: Intro sound ignored: invalid path or format.
Warn.ImageLoad: Could not load the title card background image.
Warn.SoundLoad: Could not play the title card intro sound.
Warn.CounterDisabled: The text contains {{n}} but the session counter is disabled: the token will be shown as is.

Overlay.CloseBanner: Close the banner (Esc when this button has focus)

FontFamily.Name: Font
FontFamily.Hint: Font used for every text of the card. The list comes from the fonts registered in Foundry.

SubtitleColor.Name: Subtitle color
SubtitleColor.Hint: Ochre by default (#c9b98f). Also used for the ambience text.

TitleSize.Name: Title size (px)
TitleSize.Hint: Maximum size. It is reduced automatically on small screens.

Shadow.Name: Drop shadow
Shadow.Hint: Shadow applied to the card texts.

DefaultFadeIn.Name: Default fade in (ms)
DefaultFadeIn.Hint: Used when a macro does not specify a duration.

DefaultHold.Name: Default display time (ms)
DefaultHold.Hint: Time during which every text stays fully visible.

MuteSound.Name: Disable intro sound
MuteSound.Hint: If checked, you will never hear title card sounds (this setting is specific to your browser).

MasterVolume.Name: Intro sound volume
MasterVolume.Hint: Multiplies the volume chosen by the GM (this setting is specific to your browser).

Field.Title: Title
Field.TitleHint: Use {{n}} to insert the session number.
Field.Subtitle: Subtitle (optional)
Field.TaglineHint: Small italic text, for example a date or a place.
Field.UseCounterHint: Replaces {{n}} and increments the counter each time the card is shown to everyone.
Field.ModeHint: The banner appears at the bottom of the screen, with no full-screen black veil, without blocking clicks and without a background image. Esc only closes it while its close button (bottom right) has focus: otherwise, click that button.
Field.PreloadHint: Loads the image and sound in the players' browsers so the card shows without delay.

Presets.Overwrite: A preset named "{name}" already exists. Replace it?

Preload.Sent: Preload requested from the selected players.

Audience.Hint: Choose who receives the card and the preload. By default every connected user. The GM always sees their own card.
Audience.Empty: No other user in this world.
Audience.SentTo: Card sent to the selected users ({count}).

Duration.Label: Card length
Duration.Custom: Custom durations (set in the advanced options).
